en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
zaothra âyese ýeshti baresma âyese ýeshti,
baresma âyese ýeshti zaothra âyese ýeshti,
zaothra hadha-baresma âyese ýeshti baresma hadha-zaothra
âyese ýeshti, ahmya zaothre imat baresma âyese
ýeshti, ana baresmana imãm zaothrãm âyese
ýeshti, hadha-zaothrem imat baresma âyese ýeshti,
imat baresma (zôt,) hadha-zaothrem hadha-aiwyånghanem
ashaya frastaretem âyese ýeshti!
segments.en:
I desire the libations [Zaothras] for this Yasna; I desire
the Baresman for this Yasna. I desire the Baresman for this Yasna;
I desire the libations for this Yasna. I desire the libations
together with Baresman for this Yasna; I desire the Baresman together
with the libations for this Yasna. With this libation I desire
this Baresman for this Yasna. With this Baresman I desire this
libation for this Yasna. This Baresman with the libation I desire
for this Yasna. I desire for this Yasna this Baresman with this
libation and with its kusti, and spread with Asha.
segments.zh:
我渴望祭酒[Zaothras]供此亞斯納；我渴望
此亞斯納的巴爾斯曼。我渴望巴爾斯曼供此亞斯納；
我渴望祭酒供此亞斯納。我渴望祭酒
與巴爾斯曼共供此亞斯納；我渴望巴爾斯曼一起
與祭酒供此亞斯納。以此祭酒我渴望
此巴爾斯曼供此亞斯納。以此巴爾斯曼我渴望此
此亞斯納的祭酒。我欲此巴雷斯曼帶祭酒。
為此亞斯納。我欲為此亞斯納此巴雷斯曼帶此。
祭酒並帶其庫斯提，並以阿沙鋪開。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ahurem mazdãm ashavanem
ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti, ameshâ speñtâ
huxshathrâ hudhånghô âyese ýeshti!
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the
Ashawan Ahura Mazdah, the master of Asha. I desire for this Yasna
the well-ruling, judicious Amesha Spentas.
segments.zh: 以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙萬阿胡拉‧馬茲達，阿沙的主宰。我為此亞斯納祈求善於統治、明智的大天神。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca asnya ashavana ashahe ratavô
âyese ýeshti, hâvanîm ashavanem ashahe
ratûm âyese ýeshti, sâvanghaêm
vîsîmca ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm
hazangra- gaoshem baêvare-cashmanem aoxtô-nâmanem
ýazatem âyese ýeshti, râma hvâstrem
âyese ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the
Asha-sanctified Asnya, the master of Asha. I desire for this Yasna
the Asha-sanctified Hawan, the master of Asha. I desire for this
Yasna the Savanghi and the Asha-sanctified Visya, the master of
Asha. With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna
Mithra of the wide pastures, of the thousand ears, of the ten-thousand
eyes, the Yazad of the spoken name. I desire for this Yasna Raman
Khwastra.
segments.zh: 以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙聖潔的阿斯尼亞，阿沙的主宰。我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙聖潔的哈萬，阿沙的主宰。我為此亞斯納祈求薩萬吉和阿沙聖潔的維斯亞，阿沙的主宰。以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求密特拉，廣闊的牧場，千耳，十千眼睛，口傳之名的亞扎塔。我為此亞斯納祈求拉曼 赫瓦斯特拉。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca rapithwinem ashavanem ashahe
ratûm âyese ýeshti, frâdat-fshâum
zañtumemca ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ashem vahishtem âtremca
ahurahe mazdå puthrem âyese ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the
Asha-sanctified Rapithwin, the master of Asha. I desire for this
Yasna the Fradat-fshav and the Asha-sanctified Zantuma, the master
of Asha. With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna
Asha Vahishta and Atar, the Son of Ahura Mazda.
segments.zh: 以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙聖潔的拉皮特溫，阿沙的主宰。我為此亞斯納祈求弗拉德-弗沙夫和阿沙聖潔的贊圖瑪，阿沙的主宰。以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙‧瓦希什塔和阿塔爾，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca uzayeirinem ashavanem ashahe
ratûm âyese ýeshti, frâdat-vîrem
dâh'yumemca ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca berezañtem ahurem xshathrîm
xshaêtem apãm napâtem aurvat-aspem âyese
ýeshti, apemca mazdadhâtãm ashaonîm
âyese ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the 
Asha-sanctified Uzerin, the master of Asha. I desire for this
Yasna the Fradat-vira and the Asha-sanctified Dahyuma, the master
of Asha. With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna
the high Lord, the kingly and brilliant Apam-Napat, of swift-horses,
and likewise the water, Mazda-made and holy.
segments.zh: 以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙聖潔的烏澤林，阿沙的主宰。我為此亞斯納祈求弗拉德-維拉和阿沙聖潔的達裕瑪，阿沙的主宰。以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求至高之主，君主般且光輝的阿帕姆-納帕特，快馬，同樣的水，馬茲達製造且神聖。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca aiwisrûthrimem aibigâim
ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti, frâdat-vîspãm-hujyâitîm
zarathushtrôtememca ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese
ýeshti, ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ashâunãm
vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå fravashayô
âyese ýeshti, khnåsca vîrô-vãthwå
âyese ýeshti, ýâiryãmca hushitîm
âyese ýeshti, amemca hutashtem huraodhem âyese
ýeshti, verethrakhnemca ahuradhâtem âyese ýeshti,
vanaiñtîmca uparatâtem âyese ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the
Asha-sanctified Aiwisruthrem Aibigaya the master of Asha. I desire
for this Yasna the Fradat-vispam-hujyatay and the Asha-sanctified
Zarathushtro-tema, the master of Asha.
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the good,
mighty, bountiful Fravashis of the Asha-sanctified.
I desire for this Yasna the women who have many sons. And I desire
for this Yasna the Yairya Hushitay; and I desire for this Yasna
the well-formed, stately Ama; and I desire for this Yasna the
Ahura-given Verethraghna; and I desire for this Yasna the triumphing
Uparatat.
segments.zh:
以此祭酒和巴雷斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求
阿沙聖潔的艾威斯雷姆 艾比蓋亞 是阿沙的主宰。我欲求
為此亞斯納的 弗拉德特-維斯帕姆-胡吉雅泰 和 阿沙聖潔的
查拉圖斯特拉-特瑪，阿沙的主宰。
以此祭酒和巴雷斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求善良，
強大、豐盛的弗拉瓦希，屬於阿沙聖潔的。
我願為此亞斯納擁有許多兒子的婦女。並我願
為此亞斯納的雅爾亞胡希泰；並我願為此亞斯納
形體優美、莊嚴的阿瑪；並我願為此亞斯納的
阿胡拉‧馬茲達賜予的維雷斯拉格納；並我願為此亞斯納的得勝
烏帕拉塔特。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ushahinem ashavanem ashahe
ratûm âyese ýeshti, berejîm nmânîmca
ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti, ahmya
zaothre baresmanaêca sraoshem ashîm huraodhem verethrâjanem
frâdat-gaêthem ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese
ýeshti,
rashnûm razishtem âyese ýeshti, arshtâtemca
frâdat-gaêthãm varedat- gaêthãm
âyese ýeshti!
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the
Asha-sanctified Ushahina, the master of Asha. I desire for this
Yasna the Berejya and the Asha-sanctified Nmanya, the master of
Asha.
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna Sraosha,
companion of Ashi, fair of form, victorious, furthering the world,
Asha-sanctified, the master of Asha.
I desire for this Yasna the straightest Rashnu, and I desire for
this Yasna Arshtat, who furthers the settlements, and causes them
to increase.
segments.zh:
以此澆奠和巴爾斯曼。我為此亞斯納祈求的
阿沙聖潔的烏沙希納，阿沙的主人。我為此
亞斯納貝雷佳和阿沙聖潔的納曼亞，的主人
阿沙。
以此澆奠和巴爾斯曼。我為此亞斯納斯魯沙，
阿希的伴侶。形體美好。勝利。促進世界，
阿沙聖化的，阿沙的主人
我願為此亞斯納祈求最正直的拉什努，並我願為
此亞斯納 阿爾什塔特，他促進定居點，並導致它們
使其增加。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca mâhya ashavana ashahe
ratavô âyese ýeshti, añtaremånghem
ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti, perenô-månghem
vîshaptathem ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti!
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the 
Asha-sanctified Mahya (Monthly festivals), the master of Asha.
I desire for this Yasna the Asha-sanctified Antaremah, the master
of Asha.
I desire for this Yasna the Pereno-mah and the Asha-sanctified
Vishaptatha, the master of Asha.
segments.zh: 以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙聖潔的瑪希亞（Monthly festivals），阿沙的主宰。我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙聖潔的安塔雷瑪，阿沙的主宰。我為此亞斯納祈求佩雷諾-瑪和阿沙聖潔的維沙普塔他，阿沙的主宰。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ýâirya ashavana
ashahe ratavô âyese ýeshti,
maidhyôizaremaêm ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese
ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca maidhyôishemem ashavanem
ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca paitishhahîm ashavanem
ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ayâthrimem fraourvaêshtrimem
varshniharshtem ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca maidhyâirîm ashavanem
ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca hamaspathmaêdaêm
ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese ýeshti,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca saredha ashavana ashahe ratavô
âyese ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the 
Asha-sanctified Yairya (Yearly festivals), the master of Asha.
I desire for this Yasna the Asha-sanctified Maidyozarem, the master
of Asha. With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna
the Asha-sanctified Maidyoshahem, the master of Asha. With this
libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the Asha-sanctified
Paitishahem, the master of Asha.
With this libation and Barasman I desire for this Yasna Ayathrem,
the promoter, who spends the strength of males, Asha-sanctified,
the master of Asha.
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the Asha-sanctified
Maidyarem, the master of Asha. With this libation and Baresman
I desire for this Yasna the Asha-sanctified Hamaspathmaidyem,
the master of Asha. With this libation and Baresman I desire for
this Yasna the Asha-sanctified Yairya (Yearly festivals), the
masters of Asha.
segments.zh:
以此澆奠和巴雷斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求此
阿沙聖潔的雅爾雅（年度節慶），此阿沙的主人。
我為此亞斯納祈求此阿沙聖潔的Maidyozarem，此主人。
阿沙的。以此澆奠和巴雷斯曼，我為此亞斯納
此阿沙聖潔的Maidyoshahem，此阿沙的主人。以此
澆奠和巴雷斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求此阿沙聖潔的
派提沙赫姆，阿沙的主。
以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求艾亞特雷姆，
推動者，消耗男性力量，阿沙聖化的，
阿沙的主。
以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求阿沙聖化的
邁迪亞雷姆，阿沙的主。以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼
我願為此亞斯納賜予阿沙聖化的哈斯帕斯邁迪姆，
阿沙的主宰。以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我願為
此亞斯納 阿沙聖化的雅伊爾亞（年度節日），的
阿沙的主宰們。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca vîspe ashahe ratavô
âyese ýeshti
ýôi heñti ashahe ratavô thrayasca thrisãsca
nazdishta pairishhâvanayô ýôi heñti
ashahe ýat vahishtahe mazdô- frasâsta zarathushtrô-fraoxta!
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna all 
of the masters of Asha, the thirty-three who come the nearest
round about our Hawans, who are masters of Asha Vahishta, which
were inculcated by Mazda, and spoken forth by Zarathushtra.
segments.zh: 以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求所有阿沙的主宰，三十三人誰最近環繞我們的哈萬，誰是阿沙‧瓦希什塔的主宰，這些被馬茲達灌輸，並由查拉圖斯特拉宣說。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ahura mithra berezañta
aithyajangha ashavana âyese ýeshti, strêushca
månghemca hvareca urvarâhu paiti baresmanyâhu
mithrem vîspanãm dah'yunãm dainghupaitîm
âyese ýeshti, ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca (...rôz...)
ahurem mazdãm raêvañtem hvarenanguhañtem
âyese ýeshti, ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca (...mâh...)
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô âyese ýeshti!
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna Ahura 
(and) Mithra, the lofty, eternal, and Asha-sanctified two.
I desire for this Yasna the Stars and Moon and Sun (and) - with
the Baresman-Plants - and Mithra, the governor of all the provinces.
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the radiant
and glorious Ahura Mazda. With this libation and Baresman I desire
for this Yasna the good, heroic, bountiful Fravashis of the Asha-sanctified.
segments.zh: 以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求阿胡拉‧馬茲達（和）密特拉，崇高、永恆且阿沙聖潔的兩位。我為此亞斯納祈求星辰、月亮和太陽（和）- 與巴爾斯曼-植物 - 以及密特拉，所有省份的總督。以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求光彩奪目且光榮的阿胡拉‧馬茲達。以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求善良、英勇、豐盛的阿沙聖潔的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca thwãm âtrem
ahurahe mazdå puthrem ashavanem ashahe ratûm âyese
ýeshti mat vîspaêibyô âterebyô,
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca âpô vanguhîsh
vahishtå mazdadhâtå ashaonîsh âyese
ýeshti, vîspå âpô mazdadhâtå
ashaonîsh âyese ýeshti, vîspå urvarå
mazdadhâtå ashaonîsh âyese ýeshti!
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna you, 
the Asha-sanctified Atar, the Son of Ahura Mazda, the master of
Asha, with all Fires. With this libation and Baresman I desire
for this Yasna the good, best, Mazda-made, Asha-sanctified Water.
I desire for this Yasna all the Mazda-made Asha-sanctified Waters.
I desire for this Yasna all the Mazda-made, Asha-sanctified Plants.
segments.zh: 以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求您，阿沙聖潔的阿塔爾，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子，阿沙的主宰，與所有火焰。以此祭酒和巴爾斯曼，我為此亞斯納祈求良好、最佳、馬茲達製造且阿沙聖潔的水。我為此亞斯納祈求所有馬茲達製造且阿沙聖潔的水。我為此亞斯納祈求所有馬茲達製造且阿沙聖潔的植物。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca mãthrem speñtem
ashhvarenanghem âyese ýeshti, dâtem vîdôyûm
âyese ýeshti, dâtem zarathushtri âyese
ýeshti, darekhãm upayanãm âyese ýeshti,
daênãm vanguhîm mâzdayasnîm âyese
ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the
bounteous Manthra, the most glorious. I desire for this Yasna
the law instituted against the Daevas. I desire for this Yasna
the Zoroastrian law. I desire for this Yasna the long tradition.
I desire for this Yasna the good Mazdayasnian Religion.
segments.zh: 以這奠酒和巴雷斯曼，我為這亞斯納渴望那豐饒的、最光榮的曼斯拉。我為這亞斯納渴望那對抗達埃瓦所立之法。我為這亞斯納渴望那查拉圖斯特拉的法律。我為這亞斯納渴望那長久的傳統。我為這亞斯納渴望那良好的馬茲達亞斯尼宗教。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca gairîm ushidarenem
mazdadhâtem ashahvâthrem ýazatem âyese
ýeshti, vîspå garayô ashahvâthrå
pouru- hvâthrå mazdadhâta ashavana ashahe ratavô
âyese ýeshti, ukhrem kavaêm hvarenô mazdadhâtem
âyese ýeshti, ukhrem ahvaretem hvarenô mazdadhâtem
âyese ýeshti, ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ashîm
vanguhîm âyese ýeshti, xshôithnîm
berezaitîm amavaitîm huraodhãm hvâparãm,
hvarenô mazdadhâtem âyese ýeshti, savô
mazdadhâtem âyese ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna Mount 
Ushi-darena, Mazda-made, the Yazad possessing the ease of Asha.
I desire for this Yasna all mountains possessed of ease of Asha,
full of ease, Mazda-made, Asha-sanctified, the masters of Asha.
I desire for this Yasna the strong, Mazda-made khwarrah of the
Kavis. I desire for this Yasna the strong, Mazda-made ungraspable
khwarrah.
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the good
Ashi, the brilliant, tall, vigorous, fair of form, self-sufficient.
I desire for this Yasna the Mazda-made khwarrah; I desire for
this Yasna the Mazda-made prosperity.
segments.zh:
以此祭酒和巴雷斯曼，我祈求此亞斯納之山
Ushi-darena，阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造，具備阿沙之安適的亞扎塔。
我祈求此亞斯納一切具備阿沙之安適的山脈，
充滿安適，阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造，阿沙聖化，阿沙之主宰。
我祈求此亞斯納強大的、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造的赫瓦拉之
我祈求此亞斯納強大的、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造的不可把握的
赫瓦拉。
以此祭酒和巴雷斯曼我願為此亞斯納求善
阿希，光亮的、高大的、精力充沛的、形體端正的、自給自足的。
我願為此亞斯納求阿胡拉‧馬茲達製造的赫瓦拉；我願為
此亞斯納阿胡拉‧馬茲達製造的繁榮。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca dahmãm vanguhîm
âfritîm âyese ýeshti, dahmemca narem
ashavanem âyese ýeshti, ukhrem taxmem dâmôish
upamanem ýazatem âyese ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna the
pious and good Blessing. I desire for this Yasna the pious, Asha-sanctified
Man, and I desire for this Yasna the strong, brave Yazad Damoish
Upamana.
segments.zh: 以這奠酒和巴雷斯曼，我為這亞斯納渴望那虔誠而良好的祝福。我為這亞斯納渴望那虔誠的、以阿沙淨化的人，並且我為這亞斯納渴望那強壯、勇敢的亞扎塔‧達莫伊什‧烏帕馬納。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca imå apasca zemasca
urvaråsca âyese ýeshti, imå asåsca
shôithråsca gaoyaoitîshca maêthanyåsca
avô-hvarenåsca âyese ýeshti, imemca shôithrahe
paitîm âyese ýeshti ýim ahurem mazdãm!
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna these 
Waters and Lands and Plants; I desire for this Yasna these places,
districts, and pastures, and these dwellings with their springs
of water, and this land-ruler, who is Ahura Mazda.
segments.zh: 以這奠酒和巴雷斯曼，我為這亞斯納渴望這些水、土地和植物；我為這亞斯納渴望這些地方、區域和牧場，以及這些帶有泉水的住所，和這位土地統治者，即阿胡拉‧馬茲達。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ratavô vîspe
mazishta âyese ýeshti ayara asnya mâhya ýâirya
saredha, ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca ashâunãm
vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå fravashayô
âyese ýeshti.
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna all
the greatest masters: the day-lords, the month-lords, those of
the years, and of the seasons, and the good, mighty, beneficent
Fravashis of the Asha-sanctified.
segments.zh: 以這奠酒和巴雷斯曼，我為這亞斯納渴望所有最偉大的主宰：日主、月主、年主和季節主，以及那些以阿沙淨化者的善良、強大、仁慈的弗拉瓦希們。

segments.orig:
ahmya zaothre baresmanaêca vîspe ashavanô
ýazata âyese ýeshti, vîspe ashahe ratavô
âyese ýeshti, hâvanîm paiti ratûm
sâvanghaêm vîsîmca paiti ratûm,
ratavô vîspe mazishta paiti ratûm!!
segments.en:
With this libation and Baresman I desire for this Yasna all 
the Asha-sanctified Yazatas. I desire for this Yasna all the masters
of Asha: Hawan at his time, and Savanghi and Visya at their times,
and all the greatest masters at their times.

segments.zh: 以這奠酒和巴雷斯曼，我為這亞斯納渴望所有以阿沙淨化的亞扎塔們。我為這亞斯納渴望所有阿沙的主宰：哈萬在其時，薩萬吉和維斯亞在他們的時節，以及所有最偉大的主宰在他們的時節。
